issues.message: No sources, ports, TFSF, or waveguide/Floquet/MSL ports configured. Simulation will produce zero fields.

all dielectric(s) ['diel_hi', 'diel_lo'] are perfectly lossless in an open (CPML) domain. If you are measuring Q / resonance, this gives an ARTIFICIALLY infinite Q (design-guide Anti-Pattern #1, an R5 surface-metric trap) — add loss, e.g. sigma = 2*pi*f*eps0*eps_r*tan_delta. (Harmless if you are not measuring Q.)

2 conductor sheet dimension(s) are solved more than 1% off their drawn size (worst 2 listed): geometry[2] 'pec' x: drawn 4mm, nodes cover 4mm, solved as 4.35mm (+8.75%); geometry[2] 'pec' y: drawn 4mm, nodes cover 4mm, solved as 4.35mm (+8.75%). OBSERVED: the node span the sheet's realized footprint covers on this run's grid, plus 0.35 of the adjacent cell at each free in-plane edge -- a PEC sheet's edge is solved that far beyond its last node (measured on this solver, both polarizations; a flat wall has no such offset). REMEDY: build the in-plane profiles with rfx.mesh_edges.edge_aware_profiles(domain, dx, sheets=[...], solids=[...]) and pass them as Simulation(dx_profile=..., dy_profile=...); a node ON the edge is not the fix. STALE IF: the footprint's node span on the run's node coordinates does not reproduce the printed numbers.

2 conductor-Box design edge(s) sit off-lattice by more than 0.5% of their extent (worst 2 listed): geometry[2] 'pec' (sheet) x: extent 4mm, worst face residual 175µm (4.38% of the extent); geometry[2] 'pec' (sheet) y: extent 4mm, worst face residual 175µm (4.38% of the extent). OBSERVED: distance from each declared face to its nearest E-node on this run's own node coordinates; a PEC volume's face realizes on the nearest node plane and a sheet footprint on the nodes it covers (lattice ownership contract #931 §1.1/§1.3). Reported residuals describe declared-face alignment only. A sheet's extent can change by more than this nearest-node residual, and an extent change involves both faces. Read the realized bounds from fidelity_report(); frequency sensitivity depends on the mode and the affected dimension. COST (measured, #703): a uniform-mesh sweep rounded ONE substrate thickness by 8-10% across three 'convergence' points — three different boards solved under one name; the same campaign's board survived at dx=50um only because every patterned dimension happened to be an exact multiple of 50um. REMEDY: for a PEC VOLUME choose dx commensurate with its dimensions, slide the lattice origin onto the worst face, or (non-uniform lane) place mesh nodes on its faces; for a SHEET see sheet_effective_size -- a node on a sheet's edge is not the fix. COVERAGE: examined 2 axis extent(s) on 1 conductor Box declaration(s) on the uniform lane; 1 sheet normal axis/axes reported by sheet_plane_realized instead; 0 non-Box conductor entr(y/ies) skipped (no analytic face coordinates). STALE IF: |face - nearest node| on the run's node coordinates does not reproduce the printed residuals.
